question: Which of the following states is NOT a major producer of fertilizers?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Himachal Pradesh.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Himachal Pradesh is** NOT** a major producer of fertilizers.
 
• **Gujarat** is one of the major producers of fertilizers in India with several large fertilizer companies such as** Gujarat State Fertilizers Chemicals Ltd. (GSFC)** and **Gujarat Narmada Valley Fertilizers Chemicals Ltd. (GNFC).**
 
• **Maharashtra** is also a major producer of fertilizers with companies like** Rashtriya Chemicals Fertilizers Ltd. (RCF)** and **National Fertilizers Ltd. (NFL) **having their units in the state.
 
• **Uttar Pradesh** is also a major producer of fertilizers with companies like** Indian Farmers Fertiliser Cooperative Ltd. (IFFCO)** and** National Fertilizers Ltd. (NFL)** having their units in the state.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A natural or synthetic material that contains chemical ingredients (such as nitrogen (N), phosphorus (P), and potassium (K)) to enhance plant growth and productivity is called a fertilizer.
 
• **Fertilisers **are chemicals or substances that are added to soil to improve its **fertility and promote plant growth.**
 
• Fertilizers are concentrated sources of nutrients for plants, typically in the form of** pellets, granules, liquids, or powder**s.
